title: GimmeRandomItems
description: Gain random items on an interval. run '/randomitems start' to start the items.
body:
This is a mod that gives you random items on a configurable interval, by default every 5 seconds. To start the mod, ensure you have operator permissions/cheats on, and run `/randomitems start`.

The mod will display a bossbar that shows the time remaining until the next item is received.

To change this interval, run `/randomitems rate <ticks>` where ticks is the amount of time in minecraft ticks between each random item.

Fully compatible with mods that add items, as this mod just pulls a random item from minecraft's internal list of items which mods register their items to.

If you have a full inventory, items will not be received, nor will they be dropped on the ground.
